subject: Supplier classification & PO trigger — Lumenix trial
messages:
From: Amanda Cole <amanda.cole@lumenix.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Lumenix Procurement <procurement@lumenix.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirement for trial with Redwood

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — Lumenix is keen to pilot Redwood for a 30-day evaluation. Our procurement team usually requires a Purchase Order to accept invoices. For short trials we try to avoid complex PO routing if possible.

Can you confirm: 1) whether Redwood can accept invoices without a PO for a timeboxed trial, and 2) what onboarding paperwork you need from us (W-9, company profile, security evidence)?

If PO is mandatory, please outline the exception path, approvals, and any dollar thresholds. We want to get this scheduled this month.

Best,
Amanda Cole
Vendor & Contract Lead
Lumenix

[Attachment: Lumenix-Company-Profile.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Cole <amanda.cole@lumenix.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirement for trial with Redwood

Amanda — thanks for reaching out and excited to run the pilot with Lumenix. Short answer: we prefer a PO for ongoing paid contracts, but we do have a documented exception process for timeboxed trials and low-dollar pilots.

What we'll need from you to evaluate an exception:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (I attached a blank)
- W-9 or equivalent tax form
- Either a recent SOC 2 summary or the completed security questionnaire

If Lumenix provides the above, Procurement has agreed to consider an "invoice-only" pathway for trials under $5,000 without a formal PO, provided the vendor is classified as a trial/partner and we have a signed onboarding form on file. For pilots expected to exceed $5,000, we typically require either a PO or a one-time PO exception signed by Procurement and Finance.

Next steps I can start from our side:
1) I attached the onboarding_form.pdf — please fill and return signed.
2) If you send SOC 2 attestation or the security questionnaire, I can loop Karthik (Procurement) for an eligibility review.
3) Once we have documents, I will open a PROC Jira (see PROC-451) and route for an approval decision — should take 48–72 hours.

If you prefer, we can inline the exceptions during the contract review and capture the decision in DocuSign.

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Vendor Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Amanda Cole <amanda.cole@lumenix.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirement for trial with Redwood

Looping in procurement notes so expectations are clear to Lumenix.

Irene summarized the program accurately. A couple of additional clarifications from Procurement's side:
- Classification: we will mark Lumenix as "trial partner" in the vendor registry. That classification is time-limited (30–90 days) and carries lighter onboarding checks.
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II is preferred; if not available, we accept the completed security questionnaire plus three references.
- Dollar thresholds: invoice-only approval up to $10k for strategic pilots; however Finance requires pre-approval in HubSpot (we need a Deal record) and a one-time approval e-mail chain saved to the vendor file.
- Controls: any invoice-only arrangement must specify invoice routing (AP contact + payment terms) and a single-owner in Redwood (Irene will be owner).

I'll add PROC-451 to track the approval. Irene, please attach the HubSpot deal link when you create the trial record — that will speed Finance sign-off.

Karthik
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
